records.source: I sometimes find inspiration in the most unlikely of places.
records.translation: Minsan ay nakakahanap ako ng inspirasyon sa mga lugar na hindi mo inaasahan.

records.source: I used to find rain depressing when I lived in the city. But here in Stardew Valley it's beautiful.
records.translation: Nakalulungkot para sa akin ang ulan noong nakatira ako sa lungsod. Pero maganda ito rito sa Stardew Valley.

records.source: Good morning! I got up early and did some mushroom hunting. Here, take one.[281 404 420 257]#$e#Searching for mushrooms is like going on a treasure hunt. It's a lot of fun.$h
records.translation: Magandang umaga! Maaga akong bumangon at naghanap ng mga kabute. Heto, kumuha ka ng isa.[281 404 420 257]#$e#Parang paghahanap ng kayamanan ang paghahanap ng mga kabute. Napakasaya nito.$h

records.source: It's days like this I'm really happy about my heavy-duty boots.$h
records.translation: Sa mga araw na tulad nito, talagang natutuwa ako sa matitibay kong bota.$h

records.source: The trees have been begging for this rain... I'm happy for them.
records.translation: Matagal nang hinihingi ng mga puno ang ulang ito... Natutuwa ako para sa mga iyon.

records.source: How was your day? Did you see any animals out there?
records.translation: Kumusta ang araw mo? May nakita ka bang mga hayop roon?

records.source: Don't look too close, it's a work in progress.
records.translation: Huwag mong tingnan nang masyadong malapitan, ginagawa ko pa ito.

records.source: I usually go for salad... but a wet night like this gives me cravings for hot soup.$h
records.translation: Karaniwang salad ang pinipili ko... pero natatakam ako sa mainit na sopas sa maulang gabing tulad nito.$h

records.source: It's going to be relaxing to fall asleep on a night like this...$l
records.translation: Ang sarap sigurong matulog sa gabing tulad nito...$l

records.source: I made a little wood sculpture today, but it was so ugly I threw it into the fire.$u#$e#I think to become a great artist, you have to be critical of your own work.
records.translation: Gumawa ako ng munting eskulturang kahoy ngayon, pero napakapangit nito kaya inihagis ko ito sa apoy.$u#$e#Sa tingin ko, upang maging mahusay na alagad ng sining ay kailangan mong maging mapanuri sa sarili mong gawa.

records.source: I'm glad you're home... It's a good night to get under the covers and stay warm.
records.translation: Natutuwa akong nakauwi ka na... Magandang gabi ito para humiga sa ilalim ng kumot at manatiling mainit.

records.source: How was your day today, dear? Muddy?
records.translation: Kumusta ang araw mo ngayon, mahal? Maputik?

records.source: This house is a lot nicer than my old cabin! I don't miss it.
records.translation: Di-hamak na mas maganda ang bahay na ito kaysa sa luma kong Kubo! Hindi ko iyon nami-miss.

records.source: Good morning, @. I've planted these in a little pot out back... [16 18 20 22 90 259 396 402]#$e#I grew that with great love and attention. Enjoy it.
records.translation: Magandang umaga, @. Itinanim ko ang mga ito sa munting paso sa likod... [16 18 20 22 90 259 396 402]#$e#Pinalago ko iyan nang may matinding pagmamahal at pag-aalaga. Masiyahan ka rito.

records.source: Always remember to keep your eyes peeled for wild food! There's lots out there.
records.translation: Laging tandaang magmasid para sa ligaw na pagkain! Napakarami niyon sa labas.

records.source: I was thinking... life's too short to eat bad food. Luckily, we live in one of the best regions for fresh greens and vegetables!#$e#Here, I made you a healthy salad. [196]#$e#I'm surprised you aren't sick of my salad yet!
records.translation: Napag-iisip-isip ko... napakaikli ng buhay para kumain ng pangit na pagkain. Mabuti na lang at nakatira tayo sa isa sa pinakamagagandang rehiyon para sa mga sariwang dahon at gulay!#$e#Heto, ipinaghanda kita ng masustansiyang salad. [196]#$e#Nagulat akong hindi ka pa nagsasawa sa salad ko!

records.source: Good morning, @! I made us some coffee.[395]$h#$e#My morning just wouldn't be complete without a hot cup of coffee.
records.translation: Magandang umaga, @! Nagtimpla ako ng kape para sa atin.[395]$h#$e#Hindi magiging ganap ang umaga ko kung walang mainit na tasa ng kape.

records.source: Something about this time of night makes me thirsty.
records.translation: May kung ano sa oras na ito ng gabi na nagpapauhaw sa akin.

records.source: The flow of time is so delicate... even the tiniest decision changes the future forever.
records.translation: Napakaselan ng daloy ng panahon... Kahit ang pinakamaliit na pasiya ay binabago ang hinaharap magpakailanman.

records.source: It's so much lovelier here at night than the garish glow of the city.#$e#Everything worked out perfectly for me. I'm very lucky.
records.translation: Di-hamak na mas kaibig-ibig dito sa gabi kaysa sa nakasisilaw na liwanag ng lungsod.#$e#Naging perpekto ang lahat para sa akin. Napakapalad ko.

records.source: I never thought I'd receive a mermaid's pendant so soon after moving here! I'm happy about it, though.$l
records.translation: Hindi ko inakalang makatatanggap ako ng Palawit ng Sirena agad matapos lumipat dito! Pero masaya ako rito.$l

records.source: I saw a wild rabbit today. I just wish I could pet one someday. They look so soft...
records.translation: May nakita akong mailap na kuneho ngayon. Sana ay mahaplos ko ang isa balang-araw. Mukhang napakalambot nila...

records.source: The cool breeze feels nice. It reminds me of living by the river.
records.translation: Masarap ang malamig na simoy. Ipinaaalala nito sa akin ang pagtira sa tabi ng ilog.

records.source: Hmm... I'm going to do some maintenance over here. I just get the urge to do some hammering now and then.
records.translation: Hmm... May aayusin ako rito. Minsan ay nakakaramdam lang ako ng pagnanais na pumukpok gamit ang martilyo.

records.source: It's going to be a special day, I can sense it.
records.translation: Magiging natatangi ang araw na ito, nararamdaman ko.

records.source: Ah... that smell of fresh dirt. There's nothing quite like it.$h#$e#You can just tell the air is clean here... it feels good in the lungs.
records.translation: Ah... ang amoy ng sariwang lupa. Wala talagang katulad nito.$h#$e#Masasabi mong malinis ang hangin dito... masarap itong langhapin.

records.source: Don't overwork yourself, dear.#$e#Make sure and take a break every now and then, or get something to eat.$h
records.translation: Huwag mong pagurin nang sobra ang sarili mo, mahal.#$e#Tiyaking magpahinga paminsan-minsan, o kumain ka.$h

records.source: I'm going to take a nature walk today. I need to get out of the house.
records.translation: Maglalakad ako sa kalikasan ngayon. Kailangan kong lumabas ng bahay.

records.source: I had a nice, relaxing time today. How did your day go?
records.translation: Naging masaya at nakapagpahinga ako ngayon. Kumusta ang araw mo?

records.source: It's fun to be a parent. I want to make sure %kid1 grows up to have a love for the outdoors.
records.translation: Masayang maging magulang. Gusto kong tiyaking paglaki ni %kid1 ay mamahalin niya ang kalikasan.

records.source: We've got a wonderful farm and a full family. Our new life has really turned out well, hasn't it?
records.translation: Mayroon tayong kahanga-hangang bukid at kumpletong pamilya. Napakaganda talaga ng kinahinatnan ng bago nating buhay, hindi ba?

records.source: Living here, I feel like I'm on the summit of a great mountain.
records.translation: Sa pagtira rito, para akong nasa tuktok ng isang dakilang bundok.

records.source: Did I ever tell you... when you first moved here I had a dream that we'd be together someday.
records.translation: Nasabi ko na ba sa iyo... noong una kang lumipat dito, napanaginipan kong magkakatuluyan tayo balang-araw.

records.source: Sometimes it's hard not to believe in destiny... the fact that I decided to move here, and that we found each other.#$b#It could've gone entirely differently at any point.
records.translation: Minsan ay mahirap hindi maniwala sa tadhana... ang katotohanang nagpasiya akong lumipat dito at natagpuan natin ang isa’t isa.#$b#Maaaring ibang-iba ang naging takbo ng lahat sa anumang sandali.

records.source: Wow, you look full of energy today!$l^You look beautiful today.$l
records.translation: Grabe, mukha kang punô ng sigla ngayon!$l^Napakaganda mo ngayon.$l

records.source: Mmm... You smell nice today.
records.translation: Mmm... Mabango ka ngayon.

records.source: I was just admiring my wedding amulet... I'll cherish this treasure for the rest of my life.$l
records.translation: Hinahangaan ko lang ang palawit ko sa kasal... Pahahalagahan ko ang kayamanang ito habambuhay.$l

records.source: Be careful out there! Sometimes I worry about you falling into a mine shaft.
records.translation: Mag-ingat ka roon! Minsan ay nag-aalala akong baka mahulog ka sa hukay ng minahan.

records.source: @? I just want to say that I appreciate all the hard work you do for our household.$h
records.translation: @? Gusto ko lang sabihing pinahahalagahan ko ang lahat ng pagsisikap mo para sa tahanan natin.$h

records.source: Don't worry about me... I know you've got a lot of responsibilities outside of the house. I'm fine in here by myself!$l
records.translation: Huwag kang mag-alala sa akin... Alam kong marami kang pananagutan sa labas ng bahay. Ayos lang akong mag-isa rito!$l

records.source: Oh, I'm not bored... I'm just enjoying what we have here.#$e#It's a simple life, but I like it.$h
records.translation: Ah, hindi ako naiinip... Nasisiyahan lang ako sa mayroon tayo rito.#$e#Payak ang buhay, pero gusto ko ito.$h

records.source: I hope you'll still like me when I'm old and gray.
records.translation: Sana ay gusto mo pa rin ako kapag matanda at ubanin na ako.

records.source: I wonder who lived here before us?
records.translation: Sino kaya ang tumira rito bago tayo?

records.source: Don't you have anything to do today?
records.translation: Wala ka bang kailangang gawin ngayon?

records.source: If you go into town, make sure and say hi to everyone for me.
records.translation: Kung pupunta ka sa bayan, pakikumusta mo ako sa lahat.

records.source: I'll do the laundry tomorrow morning before you get up... that way you won't have any down-time.
records.translation: Maglalaba ako bukas ng umaga bago ka bumangon... Sa ganoong paraan ay hindi ka maaantala.

records.source: Are we doing okay on money, @?
records.translation: Ayos ba tayo sa pera, @?

records.source: I wonder what everyone in town is doing today?
records.translation: Ano kaya ang ginagawa ng lahat sa bayan ngayon?

records.source: I don't really feel like doing anything today.
records.translation: Wala talaga akong ganang gumawa ng anuman ngayon.

records.source: No matter how much I clean, the house keeps getting dirty again.#$e#I guess farms can be kind of dirty.
records.translation: Gaano man ako maglinis, paulit-ulit na dumurumi ang bahay.#$e#Siguro ay medyo marumi talaga ang mga bukid.

records.source: I wonder if we'll live here our entire lives?
records.translation: Dito kaya tayo titira habambuhay?

records.source: ...Do you still love me?$s
records.translation: ...Mahal mo pa rin ba ako?$s

records.source: *sigh*... Maybe we got married too young.$s
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*... Baka masyado pa tayong bata nang magpakasal.$s

records.source: Are you still happy with me?$s
records.translation: Masaya ka pa rin ba sa piling ko?$s

records.source: Did I do something wrong? You've been acting different lately.$s
records.translation: May nagawa ba akong mali? Kakaiba ang kilos mo nitong huli.$s

records.source: Do you ever wonder what else is out there?$s
records.translation: Iniisip mo ba kung ano pa ang naroon sa labas?$s

records.source: You used to be romantic... what happened?$s#$e#I know I'm not as young as I used to be... is that what you married me for?$a
records.translation: Romantiko ka noon... ano ang nangyari?$s#$e#Alam kong hindi na ako kasingbata ng dati... iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit pinakasalan mo ako?$a

records.source: We only have one short life to live... is this the best way to do it?$s
records.translation: Iisa lang ang maikling buhay natin... ito ba ang pinakamagandang paraan para gugulin iyon?$s

records.source: I used to be your sweetie... now you only seem to put up with me when I make a hot dinner.$s
records.translation: Mahal mo ako noon... ngayon ay parang tinitiis mo lang ako kapag naghahanda ako ng mainit na hapunan.$s

records.source: You've been so cold to me lately...$s
records.translation: Napakalamig ng pakikitungo mo sa akin nitong huli...$s

records.source: I wonder if I could've done better.$s
records.translation: Iniisip ko kung may mas mabuti sana akong pinili.$s

records.source: So, what are we planting this season?
records.translation: Aba, ano ang itatanim natin ngayong panahon?

records.source: That was some way to ring in the new year last night...$l
records.translation: Matindi ang pagsalubong natin sa bagong taon kagabi...$l

records.source: *sigh*... I guess it's time for the 'spring cleaning' again.$s
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*... Mukhang oras na naman para sa “malawakang paglilinis sa tagsibol”.$s

records.source: Ah, summer... I can smell the spice berries already.$h
records.translation: Ah, tag-init... Naaamoy ko na ang mga Mabangong Bunga.$h

records.source: Sorry if I'm wet to the touch... I was sweating all night in the heat.
records.translation: Pasensiya na kung basa ako kapag hinawakan... Buong gabi akong pinagpawisan sa init.

records.source: It's summer... that means the house is full of flies.#$e#Don't worry, I'll take care of them.
records.translation: Tag-init na... ibig sabihin, punô ng langaw ang bahay.#$e#Huwag kang mag-alala, ako na ang bahala sa mga iyon.

records.source: I love fall for the mushroom hunting opportunities. It comes and goes pretty fast.
records.translation: Gustong-gusto ko ang taglagas dahil sa mga pagkakataong maghanap ng kabute. Mabilis itong dumarating at lumilipas.

records.source: Have you planned for winter at all? It's good to have a stockpile of hay.
records.translation: Nakapaghanda ka na ba para sa taglamig? Mabuting magkaroon ng maraming nakaimbak na pakain.

records.source: I know harvest season is a busy time for you. I'll try and help out as much as I can.
records.translation: Alam kong abalang panahon para sa iyo ang anihan. Susubukan kong tumulong sa abot ng makakaya ko.

records.source: Winter's here, and that means crystal fruit is in season. It has such a unique flavor, don't you think?
records.translation: Narito na ang taglamig, kaya panahon na ng Prutas na Kristal. Napakatangi ng lasa nito, hindi ba?

records.source: I'm looking forward to carving ice sculptures tomorrow. I only get to do it once a year, but it's a lot of fun!
records.translation: Inaasam kong mag-ukit ng mga eskulturang yelo bukas. Minsan ko lang itong nagagawa bawat taon, pero napakasaya nito!

records.source: Hey, here's to another great year at %farm farm! Let's have some fun tonight! [348]$h#$e#Next year is going to be great, I can feel it.
records.translation: Uy, para sa isa na namang magandang taon sa Bukid na %farm! Magsaya tayo ngayong gabi! [348]$h#$e#Magiging napakaganda ng susunod na taon, nararamdaman ko.
